purpose: Source preparation only; model weights and dependency wheels are not downloaded by this lock.

openvla.role: Original OpenVLA inference and LIBERO evaluation

openpi.role: Official pi0.5 model server and LIBERO client
openpi.archive_submodule_scope: LIBERO only; ALOHA examples require their separate submodule.

libero.role: Shared local simulation version, matched to the openpi LIBERO submodule; not a claim of exact OpenVLA paper environment

rlinf.role: piRL reference implementation; use its complete resolved environment for future training

rpent.role: Harness VLA protocol audit; current engineering snapshot, not the original paper environment
